=SELECT allocation
FROM n8n_olap.fact_market_regime_histories
WHERE time = '{{ ($json && $json.body && $json.body.selected_trade_date) ? $json.body.selected_trade_date : new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0] }}'

=SELECT 
    symbol as stock_key,
    trade_date as date_key,
    sma_20_slope_k1,
    sma_20_slope_k5,
    sma_50_slope_k1,
    sma_50_slope_k5,
    signal_crossover_sma_20_50,
    signal_crossover_sma_50_100,
    expected_return_t2_n20,
    volatility_t2_n20,
    rsi_7,
    rsi_14,
    signal_volume_outlier,
    days_since_volume_outlier
FROM n8n_olap.v_analytics_master_consolidated
WHERE date_key = '{{ ($json && $json.body && $json.body.selected_trade_date) ? $json.body.selected_trade_date : new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0] }}' 
    AND signal_crossover_sma_50_100 >= 0
    AND rsi_14 BETWEEN 30 AND 70
    AND volume >= 50000
    AND sma_50_slope_k1 >= 0
    AND sma_20_slope_k1 >= 0
    AND sma_20_slope_k5 >= 0
    AND sma_50_slope_k5 >= 0
    AND volatility_t2_n20 BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.05
    AND expected_return_t2_n20 BETWEEN 0.002 AND 0.055
    AND rsi_7 BETWEEN 40 AND 85
    AND signal_crossover_sma_20_50 >= 0
    AND signal_volume_outlier = 0
    AND close >= 15
    AND days_since_volume_outlier >= 4
ORDER BY 
    expected_return_t2_n20 DESC,
    stock_key ASC,
    date_key ASC,
    sma_20_slope_k1 ASC,
    sma_20_slope_k5 ASC,
    sma_50_slope_k1 ASC,
    sma_50_slope_k5 ASC,
    signal_crossover_sma_20_50 ASC,
    signal_crossover_sma_50_100 ASC,
    volatility_t2_n20 ASC,
    rsi_7 ASC,
    rsi_14 ASC,
    signal_volume_outlier ASC,
    days_since_volume_outlier ASC
LIMIT 501 FORMAT JSON;
SELECT stock_key FROM n8n_olap.dim_stock WHERE is_vn30 = 1

=BEGIN;

WITH upserted_order AS (
    INSERT INTO orders (account_id, trade_date, trade_type)
    VALUES ('{{ $env.SSI_ACCOUNT_NO }}', '{{ $json.body.selected_trade_date }}'::DATE, 'BUY')
    ON CONFLICT (account_id, trade_date, trade_type) DO UPDATE
    SET created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
    RETURNING account_id, trade_date, trade_type
),
order_line_items AS (
    SELECT
        item.symbol::VARCHAR(20) AS symbol,
        item.quantity::BIGINT AS quantity,
        item.price::NUMERIC(18, 2) AS price
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.body.orders || []) }}'::JSONB) AS item(
        symbol TEXT,
        quantity BIGINT,
        price TEXT
    )
)
INSERT INTO order_items (account_id, trade_date, trade_type, symbol, quantity, price)
SELECT
    uo.account_id,
    uo.trade_date,
    uo.trade_type,
    oli.symbol,
    oli.quantity,
    oli.price::NUMERIC(18, 2)
FROM upserted_order uo
CROSS JOIN order_line_items oli
ON CONFLICT (account_id, trade_date, trade_type, symbol) DO UPDATE
SET
    quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity,
    price = EXCLUDED.price;

COMMIT;
